title: Create a Linux virtual machine with OrbStack
summary: Use the `orb` command to create and start a new Linux virtual machine. You can choose a specific distribution like Ubuntu or Fedora.

steps.explain: Create a new virtual machine with a default Linux distribution. Replace <VM_NAME> with a name for your new machine.

placeholders.name: VM_NAME
placeholders.description: The name you want to give to the new virtual machine.

steps.explain: Alternatively, create a VM with a specific Linux distribution. Replace <DISTRO> with ubuntu, fedora, arch, or debian.

placeholders.name: VM_NAME
placeholders.description: The name for the new virtual machine.

placeholders.name: DISTRO
placeholders.description: The Linux distribution to install. Options: ubuntu, fedora, arch, debian.
